native_return_policy.UFCF_DCF_10Y_FADE: Current exact-listing quotes support a method-specific ENTERPRISE return; they do not produce shareholder cash-flow IRR and no bridge is supported.
native_return_policy.OWNER_CASH_FLOW_10Y: Current exact-listing quotes support OWNER_CASH_FLOW_EQUITY_IRR, an owner-available equity cash-flow convention (not necessarily dividends).
native_return_policy.RESIDUAL_INCOME_10Y_FADE: Current exact-listing quotes support RESIDUAL_INCOME_EQUITY_IRR; no active Portfolio/Watchlist native model currently uses this family.

interpretation.currency: No FX-return assumption exists; rates remain in method/model currency. Exact model listing and quote currency must match.
interpretation.legacy_outputs: Imported output-only IRRs are retained source values, not recalculated at current prices. Workbook source effective dates are unknown and exact historical quote observations are not retained.
interpretation.no_safe_metadata_derivation: No missing legacy method, effective date, or historical quote basis was filled: available metadata is insufficient to prove the original return cash-flow semantics and entry-price basis. Current native models have their versioned method, model currency, exact model listing, accepted revision effective/recorded dates, retained acceptance quote and current quote basis. Output-only legacy contracts remain unclassified (including their effective date and original exact-listing quote basis) and therefore do not qualify for derived current returns.
